notes: Chronological splits by season; no random shuffling.

Corners: BSD provides corner stats only from the 2025 season (league phase onwards; early qualification rounds have none), so the corners train is the 2025 season and validation/test split the 2026 season chronologically by its median date. Sample is thin by construction.
Cards (yellows only, reds excluded — same target definition as the domestic cards_total=HY+AY): full history since 2021; train 2021-2024, validation 2025, test 2026.
No referee features: the BSD contour does not provide euro-cup referees; domestic features are the team's state at its last league match strictly before the euro-cup date (no leakage).
Baseline is the competition rolling mean of the total (comp_*_avg), the analogue of the domestic league rolling-mean baseline.
NB2 and isotonic calibration deploy only when they beat the simpler variant on validation by more than the 0.0005 deadband (calibration: cross-fitted within validation).
